# Valuations reference

Every method of the valuations resources and every object they return. Types link to their section; objects used by several areas are in [shared objects](shared.md).

## Structure

The objects each method returns, and the objects inside them. An object is expanded the first time it appears.

- `scenarios()`: [`Results`](shared.md#results)`<`[`ScenarioValuation`](#scenariovaluation)`>`
  - `meta()`: `?`[`Meta`](shared.md#meta)
    - `credits()`: `?`[`Credits`](shared.md#credits)
  - `address()`: `?`[`Address`](shared.md#address)
    - `location()`: `?`[`Location`](shared.md#location)
    - `rd()`: `?`[`RdLocation`](shared.md#rdlocation)
    - `neighbourhood()`: `?`[`AreaReference`](shared.md#areareference)
    - `district()`: `?`[`AreaReference`](shared.md#areareference)
    - `meta()`: `?`[`Meta`](shared.md#meta)
  - `valuation()`: `?`[`Estimate`](shared.md#estimate)
  - `confidence()`: `?`[`Confidence`](shared.md#confidence)
  - `scenarios()`: `list<`[`ScenarioResult`](#scenarioresult)`>|null`
    - `valuation()`: `?`[`Estimate`](shared.md#estimate)
    - `confidence()`: `?`[`Confidence`](shared.md#confidence)
    - `error()`: `?`[`RowError`](#rowerror)
  - `error()`: `?`[`RowError`](#rowerror)

## Methods

<a name="valuations-methods"></a>
### `Valuations`

| Method | Returns | Description |
|--------|---------|-------------|
| `scenarios(list<ScenarioRow> $rows)` | [`Results`](shared.md#results)`<`[`ScenarioValuation`](#scenariovaluation)`>` | Scenario valuation |

| `withoutCache()` | `static` | Returns a copy that neither reads nor writes the cache. |

| `$locator` | `Locator` |  | `locator` | bag:&lt;nummeraanduiding&gt; or &lt;postcode&gt;-&lt;number&gt;[-&lt;extension&gt;]. |

## Response objects

Every object implements the interface of the same name in `Contracts\DTO`.

<a name="rowerror"></a>
### `RowError`

| Method | Returns | API field | Description |
|--------|---------|-----------|-------------|
| `code()` | `string` | `code` | The error code. |
| `message()` | `string` | `message` | The error message. |

<a name="scenarioresult"></a>
### `ScenarioResult`

| Method | Returns | API field | Description |
|--------|---------|-----------|-------------|
| `name()` | `string` | `name` | The name of the scenario. |
| `valuation()` | `?`[`Estimate`](shared.md#estimate) | `valuation` | The estimated value in the scenario. |
| `confidence()` | `?`[`Confidence`](shared.md#confidence) | `confidence` | The confidence of the estimate. |
| `delta()` | `?int` | `delta` | The difference with the base valuation. |
| `error()` | `?`[`RowError`](#rowerror) | `error` | The error, when the scenario could not be valued. |
